FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A48
Triangles throttle and sometimes halt for others, diamonds only preach caution for hazards, and octagons freeze every wheel outright, three shapes in rising strictness. [A48]
Why it matters: group_hint shape-ranks; prereq_hint sec12-F02; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F02, sec12-F03.
Source: [A48 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]
FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A48
Tall rectangles legislate while wide ones inform, and five-sided shields alone fence school ground, so posture plus corners name the duty. [A48]
Why it matters: group_hint rect-vs-school; prereq_hint sec12-F04; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec12-F04.
Source: [A48 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]
FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A48
Round boards foresee rails and summon eyes and ears, while left-rim pennants merely open a painted no-passing stretch. [A48]
Why it matters: group_hint circle-vs-pennant; prereq_hint sec12-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F05.
Source: [A48 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]
FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A49
Red always orders, black-and-white either orders or routes, plain yellow warns of the road and orange warns of its builders, four hues in two pairs. [A49]
Why it matters: group_hint warm-colors; prereq_hint sec12-F06; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F06.
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]
FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A49
Green points to places and miles, glowing yellow-green shields the vulnerable, blue sells roadside comfort and brown courts the outdoors, guide hues split by errand. [A49]
Why it matters: group_hint cool-colors; prereq_hint sec12-F07; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F07.
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]
FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A49
Octagon red demands the dead stop, triangle red-white only bends to busier wheels, the barred red ball locks whole entries and wrong-way boards punish the reversed, four reds of climbing refusal. [A49]
Why it matters: group_hint red-family; prereq_hint sec12-F09; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F09, sec12-F10.
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]
FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A50
No-U-turn boards spare only the reversal, movement bans veto named lane turns, one-way boards jail the whole heading, and keep-right boards merely dodge mid-road blocks. [A50]
Why it matters: group_hint rule-scopes; prereq_hint sec12-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F11, sec12-F12.
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]
FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A51
Signal-ahead and stop-ahead boards preview forced halts, lane-shrink and merge boards negotiate the funnel, and advisory plaques price the bend in safe speed. [A51]
Why it matters: group_hint warn-jobs; prereq_hint sec12-F15; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F15, sec12-F18.
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0051]
FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A52
Arrow boards sketch bends with safe-speed hints while shields wear rank in shape and hue, one reading the curve and the other the map. [A52]
Why it matters: group_hint guide-pair; prereq_hint sec12-F20; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec12-F20, sec12-F21.
Source: [A52 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0052]
FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A53
Green destination boards aim at exits and miles, green info boards print borders and landmarks, blue squares sell services, brown beckons leisure, and orange work boards with flaggers rule the crew zone, color sorting the errand. [A53]
Why it matters: group_hint service-colors; prereq_hint sec12-F23; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F22, sec12-F23, sec12-F24, sec12-F25.
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0053]
FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A54
The yellow X warns from afar, the white crossbuck yields at the rails, and gates with blinkers jail wheels until arms rise and lamps die, three rail guards in rising command. [A54]
Why it matters: group_hint rail-trio; prereq_hint sec12-F27; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec12-F27, sec12-F28.
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0054]
